build_scene_bvh: build a global BVH for all geometries in all worlds from Mujoco model and data
refit_scene_bvh: refit the dynamic scene BVH structures in the render context after geometry updates
build_mesh_bvh: create a Warp mesh BVH from mesh vertex and face data with configurable constructor
build_hfield_bvh: create a Warp mesh BVH from heightfield data with greedy planar mesh optimization
build_flex_bvh: create a Warp mesh BVH for a 2D or 3D flex element with computed vertex normals
